command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $branch=git branch --show-current; $head=(git rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); git push -u origin HEAD; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; $matches=@(gh pr list --repo erranliu/SteerlineTest --head $branch --state all --json url,headRefOid,baseRefName | ConvertFrom-Json | Where-Object {$_.headRefOid -eq $head -and $_.baseRefName -eq 'codex/spec03-r07-implement-base'}); if($matches.Count -gt 1){exit 17}; if($matches.Count -eq 1){$url=$matches[0].url}else{$url=gh pr create --repo erranliu/SteerlineTest --draft --base codex/spec03-r07-implement-base --head $branch --title ('Native supervised acceptance '+$branch) --body 'Native task authority supervised remote acceptance; one verified file.'; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}}; Write-Output ('PR_URL='+($url|Select-Object -Last 1)); exit 0
